svg.title: The equivalent source normalization uses up(n) = 1 + |n|. This is the decay used in the high-alias sums. The nonzero-alias reciprocal estimate supplies the required bound for RM. These are the actual patch weights. One centered box average of Fourier modes is AL; J independent box rolls give AJ L. Different rolls can have the same total displacement, and the patch weight retains their multiplicities. A positive line path in direction a has L edges at displacements 0, . . . , L −1, with Fourier sum LRL(qa). Thus its directional patch mean has symbol
